verses.1: Cry out in the wilderness, do not be silent! Let your voice be heard, so that I may tell my people about their sins. And to the house of Jacob, about their transgressions.
verses.2: And I will be their teacher day by day. They desire to know my ways, just as those who do righteousness and follow their God’s laws do. They ask me about the laws of justice, because they desire to follow God’s laws.
verses.3: Why have we suffered, and why haven’t we seen their troubles? Our hearts remain hidden from them. On the day you die, you will find relief from all your troubles.
verses.4: They also will quarrel and fight with each other. But those who are evil will not be allowed to speak out in their own voices, just as they were not allowed to do yesterday.
verses.5: It will be a day of choice for him. It will be a day when man’s soul is broken, as if his head were cut off. And then, the Lord will call him by his name. It will be a day of desire for the Lord.
verses.6: Now, let him be chosen as a leader. Open the gates of evil; let all the evil deeds be revealed. And send out those who are searching for truth. All those who are in need shall be provided for.
verses.7: Do not give food to the hungry, nor to those who are in need. You will bring about destruction and ruin. Do not treat your children with kindness; they will become like those who are cursed.
verses.8: Then, your darkness will be dispelled, and your darkness will quickly vanish. Your righteousness will shine forth before you, as God will gather you together.
verses.9: Then you shall call, and Jehovah will answer. He will say, “Here I am! If you remove the burden from your shoulders, then I will send him to you.”
verses.10: And your soul will be revived by the hunger; your spirit will be filled with joy. It will shine in the darkness, and your darkness will be transformed into light.
verses.11: And the LORD will always be with you, and He will bless your soul and your body. You will become like a beautiful garden, and like water that never dries up.
verses.12: And from you were created those ruins of eternity—those structures that stand forever. They call you “the Lord of the Rumbling.”
verses.13: If you sit down to rest your feet on the Day of Rest, then do what is pleasing to you. Call upon the Day of Rest, and honor God in His holiness. Avoid doing those things that go against your desires and words.
verses.14: Then you will rejoice in the LORD, and you will ride on the heights of the earth. You will eat the land that was given to your father Jacob, for the LORD has spoken.”
